Panels
Parameters ▾
Map Display ▾
The raw scans have a direction-dependent offset: alternate circumferential lines read ~7–12 mils apart (up to ~24), which shows as horizontal stripes. Line-pair correction estimates that offset locally (15×15 reading window) and removes it, splitting the difference between the two line sets. It changes the UT values used for both the map and all measurements, so confirm with the scan operator before relying on corrected depths. Colour mode and smoothing are display-only.
Wall loss = (Ref WT − UT) ÷ Ref WT. "Local median" uses the median UT in a 2 in band around each box, which removes mill WT variation from the depth estimate.
ILI Call Position Reference ▾
Offsets shift the ILI boxes and the auto-search window only. AUT measurements are never moved. Positive axial = downstream, positive circ = clockwise.
AUT Scan Registration ▸
Scan Y is read as inches from the upstream girth weld (same datum as the tally's "Dist. to US Girth Weld"). Scan X span is —.
Auto-Correlation ▸
Auto finds the lowest valid UT inside the ILI box + pad, then grows a region of connected readings whose wall loss ≥ max(threshold, boundary % × peak). Peaks below threshold are marked No Metal Loss.
Depth Scale (% wall loss) ▾
Internal metal-loss assessment of the AUT grid — Creaform/VXintegrity style. Cells with depth ≥ critical factor form indications; indications within the interaction distance are grouped into IML features and assessed (B31G, Modified B31G, Effective Area).
Interaction
Depth basis
Filter
—
Flow stress / pressure
Sflow B31G = 1.1 × SMYS · Sflow Mod. B31G / Eff. area = SMYS + 10 ksi (ASME B31G-2012). Depth = nominal WT − valid UT; invalid readings count as no loss. Line-pair correction, if on, is applied.
